verdict.rationale: Per-contact visibility and control inside an automation is a fair question for a marketing automation product, so the axis applies. The pack only mentions setting up 'simple workflows' after an email send and aggregate customer-journey analytics. Nothing documents seeing an individual contact's current step, or unenrolling and re-enrolling them without disrupting the workflow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
